description: A black perforated base plate sits on the bed, with an upright dark bracket/fixture, a couple of loose screws, and an L‑shaped Allen key nearby. The left hand lifts the bracket onto the base and steadies it upright, then picks up the Allen key and inserts it into a screw at the bracket’s foot, rotating the key back and forth to tighten/loosen the screw while keeping the fixture aligned.
